entries.proposition: Class-level design for a misfolded missense protein: the mutant GAT-1 accumulates in the ER (about 30 percent of wild-type signal overlaps the ER marker against about 76 percent for Ala305Val) and PBA lowers the overlap to about 36 percent and restores total fluorescence from about 25 to about 47.5 arbitrary units, in human astrocytes.
entries.snippet: Approximately ~30% of wildtype GAT-1YFP fluorescence overlapped with the ER marker, compared with approximately 76% for p.Ala305Val; PBA treatment reduced p.Ala305Val/ER overlap to approximately 36%

experimental_context.system: HEK293T cells and human iPSC-derived astrocytes and cortical neurons expressing rat GAT-1-EYFP variants (SLC6A1 p.Ala305Val); membrane transporter, ER trafficking (NOT WWOX evidence)
experimental_context.genotype: de novo SLC6A1 missense, heterozygous modelled by 1:1 cDNA co-expression
experimental_context.comparator: wild-type GAT-1; Ala305Thr and Ser295Leu comparators

entries.proposition: Heterozygous-condition GABA uptake is 0.59 of wild type in HEK293T (0.66 in astrocytes and neurons) and PBA brings it to 1.01 to 1.04, TUDCA and salubrinal to 0.82 to 0.92; the readout is a radiolabelled uptake in transfected cells, with n and replicates not stated in the text.
entries.snippet: The heterozygous GABA uptake increased to 1.01 with PBA; to 0.815 with TUDCA and 0.82 with salubrinal.
